'''Londar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Londar appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Hoth Equipment Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock, though he was later relabeled as the Level 38 Equipment Vendor. Another Sergeant Londar was later added as the Makeb Commendations Vendor, but is a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. The Human Londar was later removed from the game along with the rest of the planetary Equipment Commendations vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].<ref name="TOR" />
